q2: Is my business too small for this?
a2: If you already have customers writing to you, it isn't. The smaller the team, the heavier every unanswered message and every payment that goes cold.
q3: Do I need to know about technology?
a3: No. You describe your business and approve what we show you. We do the rest and hand you a simple manual.
q4: Where does my customers' money go?
a4: Into your own Stripe account, connected to your bank. Forja Labs never touches your payments.
q5: Can the agent make things up?
a5: It is trained on your real business information and with explicit instructions on what not to answer. When it doesn't know something, it says so and hands the conversation over. You approve the answers before it goes live.
q6: Will the agent scare my customers off?
a6: It introduces itself as an assistant, never pretends to be you, and hands over the conversation as soon as there is a complaint, a negotiation or a delicate case. The real alternative isn't you replying instantly: it's nobody replying.

a7: Because every conversation consumes AI and hosting that are paid month by month. Once delivered, the page consumes nothing: its maintenance is optional.
